extra.description: PRODUCTION. iter15_65tkr_reb21 + post-prediction value-trap gate. The value-trap gate zeroes score for (cheap PE z<-0.5) & (momentum_252d<-0.5) & (oper_margin_accel>+0.5). CS-DR-Alpha is OFF (2026-06-10): the original validation had two confounds (walk-forward fold-skip kept DR inactive for the first ~5y of the backtest; the 2-pass path skipped the prediction EMA, so passthrough regions traded the un-smoothed raw LGBM signal). After fixing both, the honest 2x2 ablation (outputs/dr_ablation_2x2, data vintage 2026-06-05) shows DR's marginal contribution is decisively negative: dIR -0.71 (no-EMA pair) / -0.58 (EMA pair) vs the matching baseline, in every sub-period including fully-trained P3. Lower turnover (-0.16~-0.23) does not compensate. See docs/RL_DR_ALPHA_RESULTS.md (2026-06-10 re-validation) before re-enabling.
